typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Pest left the party he was invited to almost immediately. He thought he could handle it but there was no way. He stood outside the door, before digging in his coat pocket and tugging out a cigarette. He lit it and began taking drags. He could hear the music from inside, though it was atleast a bit muffled due to the distance between him and the house.*

*He stared at the sky as he smoked, wishing he hadnt came at all. What a waste.*
